meta.title: Scenario: asymmetric ratings (Lantern Studio)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (asymmetric-ratings) with seed 20261102. 20 members in four teams, every rating given. Members two or more levels junior rate seniors higher than seniors rate them; DES04 rates every colleague generously and ENG05 harshly; three pairs rate each other warmly one way and coolly the other (DES06–CLI02, ENG03–LEA03, CLI04–DES02); Client Services rely on Engineering, which rarely works with them in return (CLI03, CLI02, CLI04 to ENG02 and ENG04 most of all).

layers.label: Connection strength

layers.label: Valence

layers.label: Informal collaboration
